purpose: Real-time order tracking handoff for mobile apps. Customer and driver apps subscribe to a per-order SignalR group on /hubs/order-tracking and receive live driver location updates plus order status and arrival events. The same hub powers vendor and admin web dashboards.

connection_requirements.hub_url_rule: If API base URL is https://api.example.com/api then the SignalR hub URL is https://api.example.com/hubs/order-tracking
connection_requirements.signalr_auth_note: Pass the access token via accessTokenFactory. The hub also accepts ?access_token=<jwt> query string for SDKs that do not support factories.

authorization.policy: Authenticated users only. Subscription to a specific order is validated server-side.

rules.subscribe_allowed_when: An active DeliveryAssignment exists where Driver.UserId == currentUserId and AssignmentStatus is not Rejected/Cancelled

client_invocations.behavior: Adds the connection to the order-{orderIdN} group after authorization check. Idempotent for the same orderId.
Removes the connection from the order group. Safe to call even if not subscribed.

events.frequency_hint: Approximately the rate at which the driver app posts location (recommended every 4-6 seconds while serving an order)

events.trigger: Order status transition published by the OrderStatusChangedNotification pipeline (vendor accept, driver pickup, delivery, cancellation, etc.)

rest_endpoints.name: Driver location update (push)
rest_endpoints.side_effect: Persists DriverLocation row and broadcasts ReceiveDriverLocation to every active order group for that driver

rest_endpoints.name: Customer order tracking snapshot
rest_endpoints.purpose: Initial payload when opening the tracking screen. After the first call, rely on SignalR events for live updates.

client_lifecycle: 1. Authenticate and obtain access token via REST
2. Open OrderDetail / Tracking screen with orderId
3. GET /api/orders/{orderId}/tracking to render the initial map and current status
4. Build and start the SignalR hub connection
6. on('ReceiveDriverLocation') -> update only the driver marker (no full re-render)
7. on('ReceiveOrderTrackingStatusChanged') -> update banner + optionally re-fetch tracking
9. On screen leave: invoke('UnsubscribeFromOrder', orderId), keep connection alive
10. On logout / app dispose: stop the hub connection
best_practices: Always re-subscribe to every active orderId in onreconnected callback. The hub forgets group memberships after a disconnect.
Throttle map marker updates to at most 1 fps to avoid jitter even if the backend sends faster bursts.
Treat recordedAtUtc older than 60 seconds as stale. Mark the live indicator in a warning color and stop animating the marker.
Do not poll /tracking when SignalR is connected. Use it only as a fallback after 30 seconds of confirmed disconnection.
Catch HubException FORBIDDEN_ORDER_TRACKING and stop retry loops. The user is not allowed to track this order.
Pass the same Bearer JWT used for REST. Do not embed it in the URL; use accessTokenFactory whenever the SDK supports it.
